backtest_protocol.execution_model: Signal uses only close-of-day OHLCV available on the signal date; paper entry is next available open with production entry slippage; exit is the close ten trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.

gate2.note: The confirmation field is derived from same-date accepted-core activity and sector labels already present in replay trade rows or the shared sector map. No production behavior changed; promotion would require the same field in shared production/backtest adapter code.
runtime_fields: SPY OHLCV rows for same-window relative strength
baseline accepted-core trend_long/breakout_long entry_date by ticker

gate3.note: No core filter or core entry rule was added. The default-off paper candidate pool is narrowed by a same-sector core activity confirmation, so core survival remains unchanged from the baseline replay.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: entry / candidate_pool: sector-leadership paper candidates should only be tracked when same-sector accepted-core activity confirms the move.

2_history_check.exp-20260525-916: Raw sector-leadership top-1 improved aggregate EV/PnL but failed on late_strong regression, drawdown drift, and concentration.
2_history_check.exp-20260526-010: Any same-date core activity improved aggregate EV/PnL and no window PnL regressed, but late_strong EV still regressed.
2_history_check.this_run: Same-sector core activity has not been tested as the single confirmation field for the sector-leadership paper source.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Same three docs/backtesting.md windows; positive aggregate EV/PnL; 3/3 EV-improved windows; no PnL-regressed window; >=20 paper trades across all 3 windows; drawdown drift <=0.5pp; survival >=5%; concentration inside guardrails.

hypothesis: Sector-leadership candidates should have better replacement value when the accepted core stack shows same-date trend/breakout activity in the same sector, because the candidate is then participating in an already confirmed sector move rather than a standalone relative-strength print.
interpretation: The same-sector core-activity confirmation did not clear Gate 4; do not retry nearby sector-leadership confirmation fields on the same frozen windows without forward paper rows or a genuinely new source-quality field.
next_evidence_needed: Forward paper rows or a different source-quality field; do not keep mining sector-leadership confirmation variants on the frozen sample.

confirmation_rule.definition: candidate signal date has at least one accepted-core trend_long or breakout_long entry in the same sector

production_impact.promotion_requirement: Implement the same-sector core-activity confirmation in a shared default-off paper adapter plus parity tests before any daily report, ranking, sizing, or order behavior can consume it.

why_not_other_changes: Skipped LLM soft-ranking, SEC/Kova semantics, and expectation-revision activation because current records remain PIT/sample-limited. Skipped VCP/VBB threshold, top-N, rank-notional, absorption, and state-surface retunes due playbook freeze and recent rejections. This tests a materially different same-sector activity confirmation on the otherwise rejected sector-leadership source.
